Airoha Technology.why: Airoha designs the PAM4-DSP and TIA chips inside 400G/800G data-center optical modules and says it serves multiple global cloud service providers with them, so AI data-center optical module demand drives that product line (alongside its fixed-broadband PON, Ethernet, Bluetooth audio and satellite-positioning chips).
Airoha Technology.evidence: Airoha 2025 annual report (05-29-2026): 'Optical communications products include 50 Gbps and 100 Gbps PAM4-DSP and TIA chips, supporting 8-channel optical module products of up to 800G to serve CSPs'; letter to shareholders: 'Airoha Technology supplies single-lane 50G transmission rate PAM4-DSP chips supporting speeds up to 400G, serving multiple global cloud service providers.'

players.product: 50 Gbps and 100 Gbps PAM4-DSP and TIA chips for 400G/800G data-center optical modules (8-channel modules up to 800G, serving cloud service providers)
